page.layout: One page of text, single column, full width. Below the last line, at the right, a catchword-like signature "IOAN-" (catchword). No margin notes, no page number, no running head.

main_text.p: Si eam nunc è Gallia fugitivam Valerianus Magnus Capucinus, Valemburgii fratres Iesuitæ, aliique nonnulli in Germania præconio suo digham putant, Christianæ reipublicæ interest, ut quocunque illa transfugium facit, strigilis, quæ à piis ætatis nostræ viris, & ante sæcula duodecim à magno Theodoreto, Leonis I. Papæ familiari, orthodoxæque doctrinæ in ultimo Oriente ὑπεραστπίσῃ fortissimo & fœlicissimo, probe defricata est, in promptu sit. Sume Lector, & ad fidei tuæ firmamentum, ad errantium elenchum, ad Dei Opt. Max. gloriam, quod tibi ex animo apprecor, utere.

page.notes: The Greek word in the line "Oriente" is printed as ὑπεραστπίσῃ-like letters and is uncertain; marked as read. Some words are smudged (e.g. "strigilis", "digham", "promptu", "fortissimo") and may be misread. Catchword "IOAN-" is at the foot right. Lines are copied as printed; hyphenated line-end words kept with hyphens.
